cards.title: Documentation before code
cards.text: Every request goes through architecture, requirements, interface and plan before the first line of code. The AI receives decisions, not a loose request.

cards.title: End-to-end traceability
cards.text: Decisions, rules, scenarios, screens, tasks, reviews and tests link by IDs. You can follow a rule all the way to the test that guarantees it.

cards.title: The developer in control
cards.text: You approve every phase, decide the estimates and validate the deliveries. The AI suggests; you decide.

whatIs.academic: College project, open source, MIT licensed.
whatIs.language: The kit skills and artifacts are in Portuguese by default. With project.language: en in docs/sdd/config.yml, artifacts are generated in English — which is how the document excerpts on this page are shown.

groups.title: Quality
items: AI without context improvises. With the specification ready, it builds what was decided.
Review applies the same criteria to human and AI code — and includes security.
Traceability shows what is missing: a rule without a test, a task without a review.

groups.title: Control
items: Every decision is recorded with its reason.
One task at a time means small changes, easy to review and to undo.
You approve every phase, decide the estimates and validate the deliveries.

groups.title: Portability
items: No lock-in to one AI: AGENTS.md is the shared context that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others read.
Stack profiles: full Rails (6.1 → 8.x); Node.js/TypeScript, Python, .NET, Go, Java/Kotlin and PHP with profile and permissions; generic profile for the rest.

pipeline.intro: Pick a request and scroll: each phase shows the command, the input, the generated document and the IDs it creates — and each ID links to its parent ID.

loop.title: Execution ⇄ Review
loop.intro: One task at a time: each one is executed, reviewed and only then closed. A blocking finding sends the task back once before it closes.
loop.label: Plan tasks

trace.intro: Each rule becomes a scenario, screen, task, review and test — always with the same ID. Focus an ID to see what links to it. The example is the password recovery demand.
trace.matrixCaption: Traceability matrix for password recovery: rule, scenarios, screens, tasks and tests

commands.intro: Names are the same in every language. In Claude Code, call them with a slash; in Codex, with a dollar sign. Hover or focus a command to preview what it delivers.

groupNotes.fases: One at a time, in pipeline order. The prototype is optional.
groupNotes.navegacao: They tell you where you are and what is missing.
groupNotes.apoio: Outside the phase loop, when you need them.

sdd-architect.generates: Architecture proposal, one ADR per decision and C4 diagrams
preview: C4 context and container diagrams in Mermaid

sdd-prd.when: A demand needs to become requirements
sdd-prd.generates: PRD with RN-XX rules and CA-XX Gherkin scenarios

sdd-prototype.when: The PRD has an interface (optional phase)
sdd-prototype.generates: SPEC-UI with the UI-XX screens and their states

sdd-plan.generates: Plan with small, testable T-XX tasks
preview: T-01 … T-05 · each implements RN and validates CA

sdd-execute.when: Implement one task from the plan
sdd-execute.generates: Code and tests for a single T-XX
preview: T-03 — Validate token and change password

sdd-review.generates: REVIEW-T-XX with R-XX findings by severity

sdd-start.generates: Asks for the entry point and calls the right phase
preview: A — new system: architecture, then PRD
B — feature in an existing system: PRD
C — I already have the PRD: plan

sdd-next.when: Not sure what to do now
sdd-next.generates: Where the pipeline stands and the next action

sdd-trace.generates: RN → CA → UI → T → test matrix, with the broken links
preview: RN-04 has no test — broken link

sdd-setup.when: First time in the project, or the stack changed
sdd-setup.generates: config.yml, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, permissions and a stack report

spike.when: Estimate a card before taking it
spike.generates: The parts of the work with the hours you decide
preview: AI suggestion: 3 h + 5 h + 2 h = 10 h
You decide: 12 h — only your value is saved

code-review.when: Review a branch or PR outside the plan
code-review.generates: CR-XX report with severity and Q1–Q4 quadrant
preview: CR-01 Bloqueante · Q1 — fix before merge
